policy: A language semantic change is justified only by a concrete executable application or frozen-FRANK counterexample that cannot be expressed/lowered by the frozen semantics. Compiler/runtime/stdlib/FFI incompleteness is not a language counterexample.

open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.description: The pure ClayCode compiler and the effect/authority experiments are not yet one production source->typed IR->effect checker->lowerer->sealed host runtime pipeline for the complete application suite.
open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.falsifier: A concrete admitted ClayCode/FRANK program whose required semantics cannot be represented by the frozen BASE contract even with typed host lowering.

open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.description: Hosted application proxies exercise concurrent execution but do not yet satisfy the APP-04 cancellation/error-path acceptance contract through the production ClayCode chain.
open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.falsifier: Cancellation/error semantics cannot be represented or lowered without adding a new ClayCode semantic primitive.

open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.description: The current interactive adapter is hosted/headless evidence; target-host GUI/event/render acceptance through a typed adapter remains unproven.
open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.falsifier: A real Ubuntu UI adapter requires semantics that cannot be expressed by the frozen typed host-adapter/effect model.

open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.description: A real frozen FRANK subsystem and the full H2/H3-facing handoff have not yet been compiled through the production ClayCode chain on the Ubuntu developer target without semantic escape hatches.
open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.falsifier: A frozen FRANK subsystem exposes a semantic requirement that cannot be represented/lowered under BASE_SEMANTIC_FREEZE_V1.

open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.description: Hosted/local Linux evidence is not the project-owner-fixed Andreas Ubuntu developer-system acceptance evidence.
open_implementation_gaps_not_language_co.falsifier: Successful reproducible target-host receipts satisfying the corresponding acceptance contract.

promotion_effect: NONE. An empty language-counterexample list does not close any implementation or target-host work package.
